prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
blank_sentence: Looking back, many residents described the neighborhood association as the tenants' ______.

worlds.passage: Starting in 2019, the tenants of a large apartment complex spent two years in talks with its owner over rents and repairs. They had already formed their own committee, but its members found the talks bewildering and handed the work over entirely: at every session the association's director sat across from the owner and bargained on their behalf while they waited outside. Looking back, many residents described the neighborhood association as the tenants' ______.
worlds.explanation: The association's director bargained with the owner on the tenants' behalf, so the association was the tenants' "negotiator." "Organizer" fails because the tenants had already formed their own committee. "Observer" fails because the director took an active part in the talks, and "mentor" fails because the tenants handed the work over entirely rather than being coached to do it themselves.

organizer.why: the tenants had organized themselves before the association acted

observer.why: an active bargainer was not merely watching

mentor.why: the association did the work instead of guiding tenants to do it

worlds.passage: Starting in 2019, the tenants of a large apartment complex spent two years in talks with its owner over rents and repairs. Before the association arrived, they had never met as a group; its volunteers knocked on every door and ran the meetings at which tenants chose their own spokespeople, who did all the bargaining, and once those spokespeople were chosen the volunteers withdrew from the talks entirely. Looking back, many residents described the neighborhood association as the tenants' ______.
worlds.explanation: The association brought tenants who had never met as a group together and ran the meetings that formed their leadership, so it was the tenants' "organizer." "Negotiator" fails because the tenants' own spokespeople did all the bargaining. "Observer" fails because the volunteers actively knocked on every door, and "mentor" fails because they withdrew once the spokespeople were chosen instead of guiding them.

negotiator.quote: spokespeople, who did all the bargaining
negotiator.why: the tenants' own representatives bargained, not the association

observer.why: door-to-door work is active participation, not watching

mentor.why: the volunteers gave the spokespeople no ongoing guidance

worlds.passage: Starting in 2019, the tenants of a large apartment complex spent two years in talks with its owner over rents and repairs. They had already formed their own committee, whose chair did all the bargaining; the association's director attended every session and kept detailed notes for a public record, but she never spoke a word, to the owner or to the chair. Looking back, many residents described the neighborhood association as the tenants' ______.
worlds.explanation: The association's director attended and recorded every session without speaking, so the association was the tenants' "observer." "Negotiator" fails because the committee's chair did all the bargaining. "Organizer" fails because the tenants had already formed their own committee, and "mentor" fails because the director never spoke even to the chair.

organizer.why: the tenants had organized themselves before the association acted

mentor.quote: never spoke a word, to the owner or to the chair
mentor.why: someone who never spoke to the chair could not have coached her

worlds.passage: Starting in 2019, the tenants of a large apartment complex spent two years in talks with its owner over rents and repairs. They had already formed their own committee, whose young chair did all the bargaining; before each session the association's director met privately with her, coaching her on what to ask for and when to hold firm, then stayed away from the talks themselves. Looking back, many residents described the neighborhood association as the tenants' ______.
worlds.explanation: The association's director privately coached the young chair before each session, so the association was the tenants' "mentor." "Negotiator" fails because the chair did all the bargaining. "Organizer" fails because the tenants had already formed their own committee, and "observer" fails because the director stayed away from the talks.
